title: Remote Login
subtitle: Others can log in over RDP and get their own session

setup.text: Remote login isn't set up on this computer yet. Nyxuri sets it up in a terminal: it installs the pieces, asks for an administrator password and for the RDP sign-in.
setup.started: Follow the terminal, then check again.

connect.title: How to connect
connect.fingerprint_hint: RDP clients show this certificate fingerprint the first time they connect; check that it matches.

signin.title: RDP sign-in
signin.hint: Clients enter these first, then log in to their own account on the login screen.
signin.password_unchanged: New password (empty keeps the current one)

error.denied: Not authorized (the password prompt was cancelled or failed).
error.timeout: No answer in time; try again.
error.failed: That didn't work; see the Noctalia log.

agent_off: Changes need Noctalia's polkit agent, which is off: turn on Settings → Security → Polkit Agent.
